title: Nine Summers of Writing
subtitle: 童年与成长 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 童年与成长（生活与学习·成长与经历）
meta: 主题语境：童年与成长（生活与学习·成长与经历）　|　核心词汇：childhood　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 childhood 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1944 my mother was sent to write ① childhood she could not leave, and she said the writing was the whole of the lesson. The ② childhood, meaning the years and not the boy, was nine summers long and was written by whoever came last; childhood, she said, is the only thing in a life that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ childhood in that house had the same garden, and the ④ childhood at the end, meaning the one the sisters kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever wrote properly. Childhood, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ childhood was the whole of the man, meaning the habit it carried and not the years. The ⑥ childhood, meaning the habit and not any of that, is the only thing in a man that everybody notices and nobody questions; childhood, he said, is either something you write or the only word that means both years and a habit. She said the habit is the part they remember.

By 1959 the ⑦ childhood had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the garden. The ⑧ childhood of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine summers and eleven years of writing; childhood, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ childhood I remember is the one at the end, which was written in 1964 and is still described as the happiest in the county. A ⑩ childhood, my grandmother said in 1969, is the only thing that improves by being written; every childhood, she said, is a habit that has agreed to look like years. She said the habit was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 童年（指那些年月本身，与那个男孩相对）
C. 固定搭配：write a childhood 写一段童年
D. n. 童年（指那栋房子里每一段）
E. n. 童年（指末尾那一段）
F. n. 习性（抽象：它养成的那个习惯）
G. n. 那个习惯（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The childhood, meaning the years and not the boy
childhood was the whole of the man
the childhood had become a number in a report
The childhood of the whole thing
A childhood, my grandmother said in 1969

answers.why: write a childhood 意为“写一段童年”，1944 年母亲被派去写她走不出来的那段童年。
childhood 意为“童年、幼年”，指那些年月本身而不是那个男孩，共九个夏天，由最后来的人写。
childhood 指那栋房子里每一段童年，每一段都是同样的花园。
childhood 指末尾那一段（姐妹俩保留的那一段），是唯一有人认真写过的。
childhood 意为“习性”，抽象指它养成的那个习惯，父亲说 childhood 就是那个男人的全部。
childhood 为抽象用法，指那个习惯本身，是一个男人身上人人都看得出、却没人质疑的东西。
childhood 意为“童年、幼年”，到 1959 年这段 childhood 成了报告里的一个数字。
childhood 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九个夏天和十一年的书写。
childhood 意为“童年”，我记得的是末尾那一段，1964 年写下，至今仍被说成全县最快乐的。
childhood 为抽象总称，祖母说一段童年是唯一会因为被认真书写而变好的东西。
